newsitem.title: USA: USDA releases $205 Mln PL-480 funds to 21 nations.
newsitem.headline: USDA releases $205 Mln PL-480 funds to 21 nations.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Monday it released $205 million in PL-480 funds, including Food for Progress grants, to 21 countries.
The funds were for the third quarter of fiscal 1997.
In the past three months, PL-480 agreements were signed with El Salvador, Jamaica, Jordan and Sri Lanka.
A planned commodity purchase being developed for the Philippines was changed from rice to soybean meal.
Overall, country funding allocations were unchanged.
The sale to the Philippines would involve about 15,100 tonnes of soybean meal worth $5 million.
Food for Progress grants, which encourage free-market reforms, totaled $30 million, including to $15 million to Kyrgyzstan, $5 million to Mongolia and $10 million to Tajikistan, all for wheat flour.

The PL-480 funds, for Title I for market development, would facilitate the sale of up to 479,600 tonnes of wheat, 46,600 tonnes of rice, 26,100 tonnes of vegetable oil, 129,900 tonnes of oilmeal and 2,400 tonnes of tallow.
